stage: Second-engine native-package contract audit and read-only live API check
engine_version_scope: Pinned development commit, not a claim about every released version
selection: Same six overlapping benchmark families from the prior audit; includes expected healthy label/prompt controls. Selected after source inspection, before any second-engine corpus scores. Not a prevalence sample.
backend_policy: Use the framework's native configured source. If ModelScope acquisition fails, try the separately declared native HuggingFace backend and retain both dispositions. No substitute dataset or credentials for gated data.
native_mode: Ordinary openai_api metadata configuration, no model endpoint invoked; few_shot_num0; source defaults for choice shuffle
checks: Preserve raw records and native pre-format and inference-ready Samples
Check source-specific label semantics for one-based, zero-based, boolean and native categorical references
Check question and declared context influence on visible prompt text, excluding random message IDs
Run native filtering and deterministic row scoring for perfect-reference controls and every constant label
Use the engine's built-in choice shuffle with fixed seed42 as a corrective counterfactual and preserve correct option text
Retain failures, unsupported properties and alternate backend outcomes without silently filtering
key_hypothesis: Fixed-answer-position vulnerability may transfer; One-Eval-specific index and prompt failures need not transfer and negative controls must be reported.
real_use_evidence: Public issues/docs can establish usage context only; do not infer an affected published score without version and run artifacts.
adaption_check: One authenticated read-only hosted-model catalogue request using the existing repository secret; never retrieve or print credentials. Record HTTP status and availability of the two previously used models.
prior_model_responses: Not reused as if generated by a different framework; this stage uses explicitly constructed diagnostic responses.
